passage:
A group of students cleaned the beach last Friday. They found plastic bags, old shoes, broken toys, and more than two hundred bottles.
Kevin had an idea. Instead of only counting the bottles, he asked everyone to read the words on them. Some bottles came from nearby stores. Others had names from faraway countries.
The students made a large map and put a mark on each place named on the bottles. They were surprised. Trash from one beach told a story about many different places.
Their teacher explained that ocean water can carry things for a long distance. A bottle thrown away in one country may appear on another country's beach months later.
After the activity, the students did not just see trash as dirty things. They saw it as a message: what people throw away does not always stay where they leave it.
